stage_a_result: Committed as 1e387c3. Full-pass BPB on fineweb-edu from each final checkpoint. The curve is monotone in KV cost and NO arm beats the shipped ratio: control a8-kv4 = 1.2616, every other arm worse. All four arms inside the preregistered 0.5% floor carry four KV heads (a6-kv4 +0.07%, a4-kv4 +0.15%, a8-kv2 +0.44%, a3-kv4 +0.46%), so at this scale KV heads earn their bytes and attention layers are the cheaper thing to cut. Frontier advances a3-kv4, a4-kv4, a6-kv4; a8-kv2 clears the floor but a4-kv4 dominates it at the same 4,096 KV bytes. Every credited_bpb_delta_pct is positive, so no arm may be reported as beating the shipped ratio once its parameter surplus is paid for.
new_this_session: scripts/architecture_evidence.py gained an `all` subcommand (044ffc8) that chains export -> retrieval -> decode in one phase. The three are one pipeline over one arm list on the CPU lane, and launched separately each needed a session to notice the previous one finished. Export gates the chain because both later passes measure the GGUFs it writes; retrieval does NOT gate decode, because they are different columns off the same artifacts. A conversion stock llama.cpp refuses is that arm's finding and the chain steps past it. It writes runs/architecture/evidence/evidence-stagea.json alongside the three per-pass artifacts, and exits non-zero if any stage did not measure.
